Two distinct divergences: (1) Coconut Milk vs Coconut Water — different ingredient forms with different olfactory weight; (2) Yuzu vs Bergamot — completely different citrus materials with different olfactory character.

Two distinct divergences: (1) Jasmine Sambac vs Jasmine — specificity difference (Sambac is a variety of Jasmine); (2) Tuberose vs Heliotrope — completely different heart materials with different character (Tuberose: rich/creamy white floral; Heliotrope: powdery/almond).

Two distinct divergences: (1) Vanilla Absolute vs Bourbon Vanilla — different extraction/variety forms; (2) Sandalwood vs Cashmeran — completely different materials (Sandalwood: natural creamy wood; Cashmeran: synthetic amber-musky molecule).
